text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- France to help Morocco set up trade courts to boost foreign investment.

- Prime Minister Filali, who presided over meeting of national commission in charge of follow-up of social dialogue, says measures to implement accord on pay increases and other benefits will be discussed in cabinet.
- Trade deficit widens and is expected to worsen, especially with liberalisation of exchanges.
- Moroccan fisherman jailed for four years on charges of being responsible for death of 26 would-be illegal immigrants.
- After liberalisation of sugar imports, producers fear foreign competition as sugar prices are lower abroad.
- Agriculture Minister Ayoub says Moroccan businesses should comply with regulations of world market.
